BiblicalUsage: Ahiam, son of Sacar the Hararite, is named twice, both times in the lists of David's mighty men, and no single deed of his is recorded — the honour is the list itself.
TheologicalSignificance: A name on the honour roll carries no doctrine. But I believe the roll itself teaches something: God remembers the men who stood with His anointed, even when history forgets their deeds.
